content.title: Careers – United States Postal Inspection Service
content.text: Are you ready for a challenge? The Postal Inspection Service offers exciting career opportunities in a variety of disciplines. Every member of the agency serves with courage, integrity, and fierce loyalty to our country. If this sounds like you, join the Postal Inspection Service. Ways to Serve Postal Inspectors Postal Inspectors are federal law enforcement agents with investigative jurisdiction in all criminal matters involving the integrity and security of the U.S. Postal Service®. Postal Inspectors investigate criminal, civil, and administrative violations of mail-related laws. Learn More Postal Police Officers Postal Police Officers are the uniformed division of the Postal Inspection Service. They perform a variety of duties pertaining to the security of postal buildings, personnel, property, mail, and mail-in-transit. Explore Our Process Professional, Technical, and Administration The Postal Inspection Service has outstanding career opportunities for professional, technical, and administrative staff. These specialists and analysts provide integral support to investigations and the agency’s mission. Learn More The Postal Inspection Service does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor. Ready to answer the call? Explore our application and requirements to learn how you can join our mission. Learn More
